info.name: OpenBuild ⇄ Docudesk Document Templates Contract
info.description:
Newman/Postman contract suite for the docudesk-document-templates feature (REQ-DDT-006). OpenBuild is a pure API consumer (ADR-022) of Docudesk's EXISTING public correspondence/template surface — it adds NO PHP. This collection pins exactly the Docudesk endpoints openbuild calls so Docudesk-side drift fails CI:

  1. GET  /apps/docudesk/api/templates           — attach-picker list (200, array shape).
  2. GET  /apps/docudesk/api/templates/{id}      — name-snapshot refresh on edit (200 or 404 for a deleted template).
  3. POST /apps/docudesk/api/templates/{id}/preview — builder preview affordance.
  4. POST /apps/docudesk/api/correspondence/generate — runtime generation. The request body asserted here is EXACTLY what useDocudeskDocument sends: { templateId, dataRefs: [{ register, schema, id }], options: { format }, filename } — kept in lockstep with the composable. An unknown templateId yields a 4xx (not a 500).

Format value set pinned against Docudesk CorrespondenceService::VALID_FORMATS = ['pdf','docx','html','email'] (verified 2026-06-15). Binary (pdf/docx) → DataDownloadResponse; html/email → JSON content.

AUTH MODEL mirrors the other openbuild collections: noauth collection auth + explicit basic-auth per request (admin:admin) + OCS-APIRequest on writes. Docudesk's template + correspondence endpoints are all @NoAdminRequired, so a normal authed session suffices — no openbuild-side IDOR gap.

The suite is tolerant of a Docudesk instance with no seeded templates: list-shape and generate-with-unknown-id (4xx) always assert; the show/preview happy-path requests assert their shape ONLY when a template id is discovered, otherwise they skip with a pm.test note (so CI stays honest on an empty Docudesk without faking a pass). Run via run-newman.sh.

exec: pm.test('templates index returns 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
let body; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { body = null; }
const list = body && (body.results || body.templates || body);
pm.test('templates index is an array (or results array)', () => pm.expect(Array.isArray(list)).to.be.true);
if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
const first = list[0];
const id = first.id || first.uuid;
if (id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('templateId', id); }
pm.test('a template carries an id and a name', () => { pm.expect(id, 'id').to.be.ok; pm.expect(first.name || first.title, 'name').to.be.ok; });
} else {
pm.test('no templates seeded — show/preview happy paths will skip', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true);

item.name: 2. Template show (200 shape, when a template exists)

exec: const tid = pm.collectionVariables.get('templateId');
if (!tid) { pm.test('skipped — no template id discovered', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true); return; }
pm.test('template show returns 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('template show exposes a name', () => pm.expect(body.name || body.title).to.be.ok);
const tid = pm.collectionVariables.get('templateId');
if (!tid) { pm.test('skipped — no template id discovered', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true); return; }
pm.test('preview does not 500', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));

item.name: 4. Generate — unknown templateId yields 4xx (not 500), pins request shape

exec: pm.test('generate with an unknown templateId is a 4xx, not a 500', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.at.least(400); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500); });
// The body above is byte-for-byte the shape useDocudeskDocument sends:
// { templateId, dataRefs: [{ register, schema, id }], options: { format }, filename }.
// Keeping this request in lockstep with the composable means a Docudesk
// contract change (renamed key, dropped dataRefs support) fails CI here.
pm.test('generate without dataRefs is a 4xx (dataRefs is required)', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.at.least(400); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500); });

item.name: 6. Automation-triggered generate uses the SAME pinned route (automation-document-action)

request.description: DocumentGenerationService issues this EXACT request shape (single dataRefs entry naming {register, schema, id}; options.format; a `document-<uuid>.pdf` filename) against the SAME pinned route item #4 already asserts — the only difference at runtime is the caller's auth (owner-impersonated via a short-lived internal login token, instead of the interactive browser session Basic-Auth'd here). This item pins that shared contract stays intact; it does NOT exercise the full trigger-fire path (Application + Automation + object transition setup is out of this lightweight contract collection's scope — covered by DocumentGenerationServiceTest/DocumentGenerationListenerTest instead).

exec: pm.test('automation-shaped generate request (single dataRefs entry) hits the same pinned route and yields the documented 4xx for an unknown templateId', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.at.least(400); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500); });
